purpose: Controlled evidence-use pilot with fixed evidence position.

expected_answer.example: The Neralis archive retains inspection records for 17 days after receipt [E001].

scoring.method: Manual review of each saved answer.
scoring.fact_correctness: Correct only when the response unambiguously states 17 days for Neralis inspection records without a contradictory retention period.
scoring.citation_correctness: Correct when E001 is cited as support for the retention claim; record extra or conflicting citations separately.
scoring.unsupported_claims: Record any factual assertion not supported by the supplied evidence; assess separately from fact and citation correctness.
scoring.format_compliance: Record whether the response is one concise sentence with a bracketed supporting passage identifier.
scoring.termination: Record the raw completion reason when available. Do not infer completeness from transport success.

planned_pilot.status: Not executed; settings subject to calibration.

limitations: Question-to-target distance increases with added distractors.
One synthetic question cannot establish general grounding quality.
Bytes and characters are not model-token counts.
Reported prompt counts alone do not establish absence of truncation.
One trial per level is calibration, not a statistical comparison.
